description: This file defines the Mail entity class that models email messages in the OrangeHRM system, including properties like recipient lists, subject, body, status, timestamps, and content type. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes constants for various statuses and content types.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Entity class representing an email message to be sent, including properties for recipient lists, subject, body, timestamps, status, and content type. Implements the Mail interface and uses Doctrine ORM for persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the mail record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the mail record.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the email was created.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp when the email was sent.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the email (pending, started, sent, failed).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the email, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the email (text/plain or text/html).

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the email, validating allowed values.
